issues.where: Crops E and I, Mars's shadow-side terrain
issues.what: The encode flattens some subtle shadow detail into patchy dark areas, although crater rims and larger ridges still read clearly.
issues.fix: Give the dark terrain more bitrate or retain more local contrast in its mid-scale relief.

issues.where: Crops B and I, faint stars just outside Mars's bright limb
issues.what: Some discrete faint stars dim or disappear in the encoded haze; the brighter stars and overall limb glow remain intact.
issues.fix: Raise the local contrast of the faint stars you want to retain rather than boosting the entire star field.

issues.where: crop E (1328,704) and the empty dark sky in lower right of the frame
issues.what: in the encoded frame (right) the near-black sky breaks into flat macroblocks with faint green and magenta tint patches, and most of the faint background stars disappear, leaving only the bright ones. The source has a smooth noisy floor dense with dim stars. This is easy to see when brightened, and it shows as crawling blotches on a good display
issues.fix: give dark flat areas more bits: lower CRF or raise the bitrate floor in the stress profile, use aq-mode 3 (or a higher aq-strength) and a psy-rd/deblock tune for low luma, encode at 10-bit to stop the dark-level quantization, and render faint stars a little brighter or larger so they survive quantization

issues.where: crop H/I (224,424), the night side of the ice giant below the ring shadow
issues.what: the dark blue cloud bands go soft and blocky, with faint 8–16 px block edges and stepped tones where the source has fine streaks and a smooth gradient
issues.fix: same dark-region bitrate and 10-bit changes; add a little dither or grain to the dark limb gradient before encoding

issues.where: crop E (1328,704) terminator and crop D (368,704) dust haze
issues.what: the dim terrain past the terminator gets blotchy and loses its small crater detail, and the haze over the basin turns a little waxy. The surfaces still read, but the mid-dark texture is visibly smoothed
issues.fix: raise the bits given to low-luma textured regions (aq-mode 3) or lower CRF a step

issues.what: the two sides do not match: the source crop is motion-smeared while the encoded crop is sharp, so this pair probably comes from different frames or different motion-blur states. That makes the comparison unreliable here
issues.fix: pull the source and encoded stills from the exact same frame index or timestamp when building the pack
